[SWS_LinTrcv_00115] ⌈If development error detection for the module LinTrcv is en-
abled:
If optional transition from LINTRCV_STANDBY to LINTRCV_SLEEP is not enabled
and the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode is called with OpMode == LINTRCV_TRCV_
MODE_SLEEP and the channel LinNetwork is not in mode LINTRCV_TRCV_
MODE_NORMAL, the function LinTrcv_SetOpMode shall report the development
error LINTRCV_E_TRCV_NOT_NORMAL.⌋
